an4.6:1.7: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo appassuto hoti sutena anuppanno?
an4.6:1.8: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa appakaṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:1.9: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ,
an4.6:1.10: so tassa appakassa sutassa na attham aññāya na dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.6:1.11: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo appassuto hoti sutena anuppanno.
an4.6:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo appassuto hoti sutena uppanno?
an4.6:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa appakaṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:2.4: so tassa appakassa sutassa attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapatipanno hoti.
an4.6:2.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo appassuto hoti sutena uppanno.
an4.6:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena anuppanno?
an4.6:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa bahukaṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:3.4: so tassa bahukassa sutassa na attham aññāya na dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.6:3.5: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena anuppanno.
an4.6:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena uppanno?
an4.6:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa bahukaṃ sutaṃ hoti
an4.6:4.4: so tassa bahukassa sutassa attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti.
an4.6:4.5: Evam kho bhikkhave puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena uppanno.
an4.6:4.6: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 2.
